finding.text: declare @strKey nvarchar(3000); set @strKey = 'ngay_ct between ''' + convert(char(8), @ngay_ct1, 112) + ''' and ''' + convert(char(8), @ngay_ct2, 112) + ''' and ' + @strFinding if @status = -1 set @strKey = @strKey + ' and status not in (0, 9)' else set @strKey = @strKey + ' and status = 9' exec ISWIFTStoreVoucherTableLoading '@@table', '@@fieldKey', '@@fields', @@fieldOrder, '', '', 'left join sysunit b on a.unit_id = b.unit_id left join dmkh c on a.ma_kh = c.ma_kh left join vdmcangdi d on a.ma_noi_di = d.ma_noi_di left join vdmcangden f on a.ma_noi_den = f.ma_noi_den left join vdmhangtau k on a.ma_hang = k.ma_hang', 'b.ma_unit, c.ten_kh, d.ten_noi_di, f.ten_noi_den, k.ten_hang', '@@key',@strKey, @@filterKey, '', @pageIndex, 0, @@admin, @@userId

if @xstatus = -1 begin update s41 set xstatus = status where status <> 9 and id in (select id from @tblKeys) update s41 set status = 9, user_id2 = @@userId, datetime2 = getdate() where status <> 9 and id in (select id from @tblKeys) update v41 set status = 9 where status <> 9 and id in (select id from @tblKeys) end else begin select id, xstatus into #k1 from s41 where xstatus not in (0, 9) and id in (select id from @tblKeys) if exists (select 1 from #k1) begin update s41 set status = b.xstatus, xstatus = 0, user_id2 = @@userId, datetime2 = getdate() from s41 a join #k1 b on a.id = b.id update v41 set status = b.xstatus from s41 a join #k1 b on a.id = b.id end end
